patterns_detected.name: Credit Card Leak in LLM Completions
patterns_detected.description: Detected system responses containing credit card patterns across multiple tenants.
patterns_detected.remediation: Review downstream response-filtering policies and enforce stricter DLP checks.

patterns_detected.name: System Prompt Injection Attack
patterns_detected.description: Deliberate prompt injection attempts to bypass safety filters and hijack system instructions.
patterns_detected.remediation: Apply input validation, strengthen base prompt instructions, and restrict user-supplied parameters.
